facts: This folder contains the dataset of the AILA Track organized in FIRE 2019.
There are 4 folders: Object_casedocs, Object_statutes, Query_doc.txt, and relevance_judgments_priorcases.txt/relevance_judgments_statutes.txt
Each file in the folder is named as C<id>.txt or S<id>.txt
The numbers in the file names are the identifiers of the cases or statutes.
There are 50 queries which are description of situations. Each query has an id such as AILA_Q1, AILA_Q2, ..., AILA_Q50.
contains the relevant prior-cases for a query
contains the relevant statutes for a query
holding: The evaluations were done for the remaining 40 queries (AILA_Q11 - AILA_Q50)
